gate_checkout: detached; private target directory; immutable HEAD for the gate

checks.note: CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0; CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_INCREMENTAL=false; linker warned about __eh_frame size.

checks.command: PYTHONPATH=<gate>/python SPARK_REMOTE=sc://localhost:50082 python -m pytest -q <cases listed in pytest.xml> --junitxml=pytest.xml
python scripts/spark-pipelines-tests/run.py --spark-source <pinned Spark checkout> --remote sc://localhost:50082 --report spark-python.json
python spark-reference.py spark; python spark-typed-reference.py spark; validate recorded DDL outcomes
checks.note: DDL reference observations; not a claim that all nine BDD cases ran unchanged on Spark.

limits: Upstream Python includes inherited and client-only tests.
Full batch acceptance and the remaining Spark SDP crosswalk are outstanding.
Validation applies to CREATE TABLE with known columns; schema-less external tables retain provider inference. CTAS and table-writer validation paths need separate coverage.
Identical partition field records are rejected; exhaustive transform combinations are not qualified.
Plan errors include the observed condition in their message; exact structured error metadata is not qualified.
Typed case-distinct columns are verified through catalog DESCRIBE. Partition scans and by-name writes still fold case; retained failing fixtures are the next shared fixes.
This gate uses the Sail default memory catalog. LakeCat adapter/dependency integration has not run.
Rust and Gherkin only; no Python lint was run for this unit.

retained_failures.note: Five initial new BDD instances; typed case-sensitive metadata scenario added subsequently.
Three lazy SELECT absence checks and a pre-existing case-insensitive writer lookup. Failed fixture retained in initial-candidate.patch.
Reading the case-distinct partition schema hits the existing partition-scan ambiguity. Failed fixture retained in second-candidate.patch.
